_comment: An example of a shared TikZ format: TikZ with these packages and libraries. formatSource() of the library (library/src/formats.ts) makes the format source from it. An app owns its own list. Leave out each entry that changes documents that do not load it (see excludedTikzLibraries).

excludedTikzLibraries.arrows.meta: changes the default arrow tips of documents that do not load it
excludedTikzLibraries.bending: changes the default arrow tips of documents that do not load it
